scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the expected critical velocity and storage fraction from the paper's analytic formulas using fixed deterministic assumptions (x=0). This cross-check ensures the agent's reported values are consistent with the model derivation. A full recompute from agent raw artifacts is infeasible because the agent only submits final numeric summaries, not intermediate model states.

schema.description: A single float value representing the critical dislocation velocity in m/s.

outputs.description: Critical dislocation velocity v_cr computed from material constants.

schema.description: vd_over_vcr: normalized dislocation velocity ratio (v_d / v_cr); t_ns: time in nanoseconds (5, 10, or 20); k_s: instantaneous storage fraction.

outputs.description: Instantaneous storage fraction k_s vs normalized dislocation velocity for three time instances.

output_contract.notes: The CSV should contain exactly 30 rows (10 velocity ratios x 3 times). The checker will compare k_s values at checkpoints (vd_over_vcr = 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9) for each time instance against paper-derived reference values using a mean absolute error tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for critical dislocation velocity and storage fraction computed from the paper's formulas using material constants from Tables I and II, with x=0 for the ς path.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's equations and constants.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Checker computes gold analytically using the formulas in its prepare function.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The gold is the paper's own derived result; the checker deterministically reproduces it from the paper's publicly stated model.

steps.description: Compare reported v_cr to paper-derived gold.
